main.summary: Object-facing summary of an active `DataItem` field assertion.
main.remarks: This summary stores the minimal active assertion metadata needed for inspection without embedding the full signed assertion artifact in `DataProtectionInfo`.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty assertion summary value.

property.name: FieldState
property.summary: Current asserted representation state for the field.

property.name: IssuerObjectId
property.summary: Object identifier of the signer that issued the active assertion.

property.name: Thumbprint
property.summary: Thumbprint of the certificate associated with the active assertion signer.

property.name: CreatedAt
property.summary: Creation instant of the active assertion represented by this summary.
